book_name: 鼎湖近瓢白蚊 Peribulbitermes dinghuensis
en: Only the worker is treated in the original account. The apical tooth of its mandible is about as large as the first marginal tooth, the cutting edge between the marginal teeth of the left mandible is straight, and the second marginal tooth of the right mandible stands close to the first. About six grooves are visible on the mandibular plate. Neither soldier nor alate is described.
taxonomy_note: 原书将该种置于近瓢白蚁属 Peribulbitermes，本站现归入钝颚白蚁属 Ahmaditermes。
worker: 工蚁上颚的端齿与第一缘齿大小几乎相等，左颚各缘齿之间的切边平直；右颚第二缘齿的位置偏向第一缘齿。上颚齿板表面约有六条凹沟。
